study.notes: Everything now lives on Vercel: downloads and updates come straight from the website, with no GitHub. The setup window says Study with Sarang, the voice icon is the default, the app checks for updates by itself and asks before installing, and the browser helper pairs with one click.
study.webNotes: A Get the app banner and a real download page, a cleaner Studio with the timer kept in view, forgot password, invitations and branded emails, and an update note when a newer page is out.

md.notes: New: the Ask orb is the front door of the AI Socratic tutor, with live hints from your own provider key. The textbook now covers every topic: 83 chapters including Statistics and Probability and Calculus. 66 new long-form practice questions come with M, A and R mark schemes (written independently, not IB mark schemes).
md.webNotes: The Ask orb for the Socratic tutor, all 83 textbook chapters (new Units 4 and 5) and 66 long-form questions with detailed mark schemes.

helper.notes: A new icon, a real settings page and a popup, one-click pairing with the app (no code to copy), install buttons in the app for Chrome, Edge and Brave, and automatic refresh of the helper folder after each app update.
